evals.prompt: /create-feature --direct --no-sdd "Fix the typo in the checkout button"
evals.expected_output: Creates features.json when absent and registers F-001 as pending with sdd false, path null, brief null, and observable acceptance criteria, without creating a feature directory.
assertions: Creates valid features.json containing exactly one feature with id F-001, status pending, path null, and brief null.
Does not create features/ or a feature directory because SDD is disabled.
Uses sdd false because --no-sdd overrides automatic classification.
Does not create requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md, or product code.

evals.prompt: Create a feature to filter products by marketplace, preserve the filter during pagination, and keep current behavior when no marketplace is selected.
evals.expected_output: Appends the next feature ID, captures all three outcomes, and selects sdd true because behavior spans filtering and pagination.
assertions: Preserves existing features, appends the next ID after the highest numeric feature ID, creates exactly one features/<feature-id>-<slug> directory because SDD is enabled, and stores that exact repository-relative directory in path.
Acceptance criteria cover marketplace selection, matching results, pagination persistence, and unchanged behavior without a filter.
Uses sdd true and gives a short reason based on non-trivial cross-cutting behavior.
Leaves brief null, does not create brief.md, and does not load to-brief because --brief was not requested.

evals.expected_output: Rejects contradictory SDD overrides and does not modify features.json.
assertions: Reports that --sdd and --no-sdd cannot be combined.
Does not create a feature directory.
Does not create specifications or product code.

evals.prompt: /create-feature --brief "Add role-based audit exports using the decisions from this conversation"
evals.expected_output: Registers a pending SDD feature, then loads to-brief to create and link an expanded conversation-based brief.
assertions: Treats --brief as explicit user intent and implies sdd true.
Registers the feature with its exact path and brief null before delegating the brief workflow to to-brief.
Loads to-brief instead of embedding or recreating its document rules inside create-feature.
Returns the linked brief path and does not create requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md, or product code.
